post.title: How does AI understand that words are related? | Word Embeddings
post.subtitle:
How does a computer understand that the words king and queen are related, when it can only process numbers? 🛠️

Learn how to master From text to numbers: How does AI actually 'read'? | Word Embeddings in this quick breakdown.

📖 Read the full guide here:
https://www.abstractalgorithms.dev/

In this Short:
- How does AI understand that words are related?
- One-hot encoding creates massive, empty tables with no semantic meaning.
- Word embeddings map semantic meanings to coordinates in vector space.
- Subtracting man from king and adding woman yields queen!
- Full guide in description. Subscribe for more engineering deep dives!
